purpose: Decorative view-selector backgrounds; these are original illustrations, not geographic data.

assets.source: Built-in image_gen generation, optimized to a 192px JPEG for the view button.
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: a square background thumbnail for a 3D aerial-imagery view button in a mapping app. Create a straight-down aerial photograph of a leafy forest edge with an irregular grassy clearing and a narrow curving pale road. Dense, naturally varied green tree canopies and real terrain texture should remain recognizable when reduced to a tiny 44-pixel thumbnail. Fill the square edge to edge. Natural daylight, clear detail and tonal separation. No sky, horizon, globe, satellite device, buildings, text, letters, labels, logos, watermark, border, or interface.
